notetaker.emptyBody: Start one from the bead or the shortcut, and it lands here.
notetaker.noNotes: No notes in this folder yet
notetaker.noFolders: No folders yet. Make one to group notes by project.
notetaker.pickNote: Pick a note to read it.
notetaker.askNoMatch: No meeting seemed to cover that.
notetaker.myThoughtsPlaceholder: Type what you think as the meeting runs. Only you see it.
notetaker.noNote: No summary yet. It is written locally from the transcript.

dictionary.subtitle: Words and names the transcriber should spell your way.
dictionary.importHint: One word per line. Commas and semicolons work too. Words you already have are skipped.

snippets.subtitle: Say a trigger, get a fixed block of text.
snippets.emptyBody: Make a snippet for what you type most, like a signature or an address. Say the trigger and the whole text lands instead.

style.subtitle: Per-app writing rules the post-processor applies.
style.intro: Choose how the text looks when it lands. One style is the default; a single app can get its own.
style.disabledHint: Post-processing is off. Turn it on in Settings → Post-processing for the style to apply.

style_neutral.name: Neutral
style_neutral.description: Fixes spelling, numbers and filler words. Leaves the tone alone.
style_neutral.sample: Hey, can we take the meeting tomorrow at 12?

style_formal.name: Formal
style_formal.sample: Hello, I would like to ask whether tomorrow at 12 works for a meeting.

style_email.name: Email
style_email.description: A finished email with a subject, greeting and sign-off.
style_email.sample: Subject: Meeting tomorrow. Hi, does tomorrow at 12 work for you?

style_note.name: Note
style_note.description: A one-line summary with bullets under it.

style_code_comment.name: Code comment
style_code_comment.description: One short line per point, no markdown.
style_code_comment.sample: // Fix the race in the sync loop when two calls land together

style.contextHint: Used for apps without their own rule. A per-app rule below still wins.

help.subtitle: How to dictate, and where the rest lives.
help.step3: Release, and the text lands where the cursor is.
help.localOnly: Everything happens on this machine. Nothing is sent out.

transforms.subtitle: Saved instructions that rewrite a dictation after it lands.
transforms.name: Name
transforms.promptPlaceholder: Turn the text into short bullet points. Keep every fact.
transforms.emptyHint: Make one when you keep rewriting the same thing by hand.

diktering.minutesSaved_one: A minute you did not have to type.
diktering.minutesSaved_other: {{count}} minutes you did not have to type.
diktering.empty: Nothing yet. Hold ⌥ Space and say something.

externalNotice.title: Sent to an external provider
externalNotice.body: The meeting text is sent to {{provider}} ({{host}}) to write the note. Nothing is sent until you press OK.

detected.title: Looks like a meeting
detected.body: Another app is using the microphone. Want to record it?

meetingLive.title: Meeting
meetingLive.listening: Listening. The text appears here as people speak.
meetingLive.thoughtsPlaceholder: Type what you think. It is saved onto the meeting when you stop.
meetingLive.summaryLater: The summary is written when the meeting ends.
